name: PlayerSettingsComponentServerFacet_ReceiveSettingsFromClient
summary: The client's player-settings hand-off: the shared two-u64 BE head, then one u32 BE. 20-byte body, C2S. Writer and reader agree field for field and the committed 20-byte record reproduces byte for byte.
purpose: The player-settings facet hands the server the settings the client holds; the server changes its replicated player-settings state. Two of the plan's six inbound requests were already named and round-trip; this is one of the four that were refused on layout and is now recovered.

created_when: the player's settings are pushed to the server on entering a world
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the client's player settings

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 93 27, i.e. type_dec 2515. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head, written by FUN_1414dbca0 through htonl64 FUN_140877280 and read by FUN_14150e670. Field meaning unnamed. Body offset 0x00.

fields.name: field_b
fields.note: Second head u64; the local-player key 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in every committed body. Body offset 0x08.

fields.name: field_c
fields.note: One u32 BE written by FUN_140876e70 (htonl FUN_146166830) from the message object at +0x20 and read by FUN_14087a3c0. Meaning unnamed. Body offset 0x10.
